author: Aneeta Dhesi
content: Excellent soft play company with top quality play mats & ball ponds. I have used them twice for my children’s birthdays and have been super pleased with the products and service. The team always arrive on time and expertly set up the area. They also come back on time to dismantle it all. All the children (from ages 9months- 9 years) loved the circus theme soft play at my sons birthday. I would highly recommend Dancing Cubs.
